# ignitify_group (Resource)

A group of the tenant: a named set of permissions and the users that get them. Needs an owner key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ignitify_group" "deployers" {
  name        = "deployers"
  permissions = ["tasks.read", "tasks.write", "deployments.read", "deployments.write"]
  members     = ["ci"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The group name, unique in the tenant (1 to 63 lower case letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter or digit). A change replaces the group. The import id.
- `permissions` (Set of String) The permissions the group grants, at least one.

### Optional

- `members` (Set of String) The user names in the group. Empty when not set: a member added outside Terraform shows as drift.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the group was created (ISO 8601).
- `resource_id` (String) The server id of the group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import id is the group name.
terraform import ignitify_group.deployers deployers
```
